verdict.rationale: Snyk exposes substantial non-UI surfaces — the Snyk CLI (test, code test, IaC, fix --agentic) and an MCP server/Remediation Agent for agentic workflows — showing meaningful programmatic access to core scanning/fix functionality (snyk-gh-1, snyk-gh-3, snyk-gh-5, snyk-docs-13, snyk-docs-28, snyk-docs-29). However, there is no evidence of a documented REST/GraphQL API with full UI parity; a probe for OpenAPI/swagger specs returned 404s across all candidate paths (snyk-probe-2), and none of the docs claim the API covers reporting dashboards, policy management, or Jira integration configuration that the UI offers. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/API reference, explicit parity claims for UI-only features (dashboards, policy management, org/user admin), and confirmation the API surface matches CLI/MCP capability breadth.
